read: Trapped between 720 call-wall resistance and 715 vol-trigger support; 60 min to close, positive-gamma chop into OPEX. Reachable both ways within the bracket.

tape.now: 716.22, 60 min to close. Locked in 3-pt chop band 716.17–716.32 (ranges contracting). VWAP 715.81 sits 0.41 pts below. Momentum spent, no seller/buyer engine driving the move. Grinding toward mechanical floor.

path.why: Vol-trigger + 858M 0DTE GEX (dominant node) + 41.5k bullish 0DTE charm force mechanical floor. Retested once 14:45 with weak 30% run (1.03 pt overshoot, came back). Grind reaction into close; charm harvest intensifies in final hour. Dealers BUY into dips (short gamma on calls, need to hedge puts ITM).

Bounce-then-break at 14:30 (0.16 pt CLEAN tick, then failed to continue downside). Bullish vanna (+198.4) + system charm drift canceled the seller push. Level is compromised; only oscillates through on any rally attempt. Pass-through, not an entry.

Terminal call wall: 792M 0DTE GEX + −143.5k bearish charm (strongest seller concentration). If 715 breaks decisively upside, dealer selling at 720 accelerates rejection. OPEX tomorrow = pin gravity + theta harvest pin at 720. Requires 3.78 pt rally; only hit on a break-higher sequence.

trade.why: Mechanical floor (858M 0DTE GEX + 41.5k bullish charm + vol-trigger nominal) + VWAP 0.41 pts below + already retested holding (weak but real) = high probability of touch within 10 min. Grind entry fills on dip. Stop loss sits at 714.02 (0.98 QQQ pts adverse), target 716.97 (+1.97 pts), execution window 60 min into close.

tape.narrative: The 14:30 test of 717 PRINTED the bounce-then-break archetype exactly: a 0.16 pt precision tick (mechanical defense showed up) followed by ZERO follow-through downside, then a recovery spike. This killed the short setup. Price then rode 716 (which broke clean on 1.15 pt overshoot, no hesitation) and retested 715 on a 1.03 pt dip. The 715 retest held weakly (30% run before reversal), then oscillated back up. This is the POSITIVE GAMMA SIGNATURE: dealers fade both ways lightly, but 715's structure is the cleanest anchor because of its dominant 0DTE gamma (858M, highest in band) + the bullish charm concentration (+41.5k, strongest in band for support). The charm is a SAME-DAY ONLY driver (front-loaded 0DTE, next-week is only +1.8k); this is pure time-decay pin into today's 16:00 close, OPEX tomorrow amps the pin gravity. Price will oscillate down into VWAP 715.81 (high probability, 10–15 min window), and when 715 prints, the mechanical snap-back (dealers forced to BUY to hedge short puts + time-decay accelerating late) runs 715 → 716 → 717 boundary chop into the final 20 min. The 720 call wall is the terminal reject, not a target for today. **PRIMARY TRADE: LONG 715 on the dip, CHOP reaction (not SNAP), grind-into-close structure.**
